name: Ashera Ballancourt
original_name: アーシェラ・バランクール
source:
A hero of the country of Teresia, which is well known for their alchemy and mining industries. The Ballancourt family has passed down the sacred treasures from generation to generation and is the origin of the Hero of Light.

She has inherited the divine sword Elimzar and the divine shield Emedius; while wielding both sacred treasures, she is clad in divine flames that burn away evil.

Of the three existing heroes she is the most recent to inherit the sacred treasure, but she has experience of subduing a mighty monster and her fame is rapidly spreading. As a swordswoman, she is very proud of her skills but she also has a strong sense of responsibility and is kind to everyone she meets.

[Translated from the [url=https://ninetail.info/td16/VenusBloodSavior_character.html]official website[/url]]
